title: Apricot Chicken
description: Classic retro apricot chicken — sticky, sweet, savoury, and impossibly easy. Chicken thigh fillets baked in a glossy apricot glaze.

method.instruction: In a bowl, combine apricot jam, soy sauce, and minced garlic. Mix well.
Season chicken thigh fillets with salt and pepper. Place in a baking dish.
Pour jam mixture over chicken and toss to coat evenly.
Remove from oven. Add drained apricot halves, tucking them around the chicken.
Return to oven and bake for final 10-15 minutes, until chicken is cooked through and sauce is sticky and glossy.

notes.title: Why Thigh Fillets?
notes.content: Thigh fillets cook faster than legs (35 min vs 50 min) and are easier to eat — no bones, no skin. They also stay juicier than breast.

notes.title: Thicker Glaze
notes.content: For an even stickier glaze, remove the dish from the oven after 30 minutes and place under the grill (broiler) for 2-3 minutes. Watch carefully — the sugar can burn quickly.

notes.title: French Onion Version
notes.content: Replace garlic with 1 packet of French onion soup mix. This is the traditional 1970s version — very savoury-sweet.

notes.title: Leftovers
notes.content: Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days. The sauce sets like jam when cold — reheat gently.
